name: LONGEST SUPER FUN OBBY [901 CPs | 650 FIXED]
desc:
Minor update on October 13th, 2024:

- Purchase of Skip Stage automatically teleports your player to the next stage.
- Fixed stage 812.
- General bug fixes.

Major update on September 12th, 2024:

- Removal of broken save/load GUI. Stage progress is now automatically saved as the player progresses, eliminating the need to manually save progress and eliminating the risk of crashing or forgetting to save and losing progress.
- Skip Stage GUI now scaled to unique screen resolution including mobile compatibility.
- Improvements to dozens of stages, especially in the first 100.
- New badges for stage progress (50, 100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 600, 700, and 800).
- All broken stages fixed.

scripts.title: Get Badges

game.name: LONGEST SUPER FUN OBBY [901 CPs | 650 FIXED]

scripts.features: Get "The Longest Super Fun Obby Completionist" and "I Beat Obstacle 901" badges.
scripts.script:
local HRP = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart
for i, v in workspace:GetChildren() do
	if v.Name == "BadgeAwarder" then
		local Badge = v.Platform
		firetouchinterest(HRP, Badge, 1)
	end
end
